title: Proration of Parking License Early Cancellation Fees by Unexpired Commitment
content:
**Proration factor** (Parking License early cancellation fee). The share of the commitment still unexpired at the notice date scales the fee.

**Definitions.** The held months are the whole months from the license's start date to the notice date, and the unexpired months are the commitment months less the held months, never below zero.

**Rule.** When the held months are at least half the commitment months, the proration factor is the unexpired months divided by the commitment months; when the held months are at least one but less than half the commitment months, the proration factor is the unexpired months divided by the commitment months but no less than 0.5; in every other case the proration factor is one and the fee is not prorated.

**Effect.** The fee months times the fee base is multiplied by the proration factor; the product is carried unrounded.

## Proration factor by held months

| Commitment months | Held months | Tier | Proration factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0 | fewer than one held month | 1 (not prorated) |
| 6 | 1 | at least one, less than half | 5 divided by 6, about 0.8333 (not below 0.5) |
| 6 | 2 | at least one, less than half | 4 divided by 6, about 0.6667 |
| 6 | 3 | at least half | 3 divided by 6, that is 0.5 |
| 6 | 4 | at least half | 2 divided by 6, about 0.3333 |
| 3 | 1 | at least one, less than half | 2 divided by 3, about 0.6667 |
| 3 | 2 | at least half | 1 divided by 3, about 0.3333 |

The figures in this table are hypothetical combinations chosen to show each tier; "half the commitment months" is compared exactly, so 3 held months out of 6 is at least half.
